name: User Account Emails
description: lets admins send account emails to users.
project_description:
Features 
 This module allows administrators to send user account emails, for example, a password reset email, to other user accounts. The emails will be sent to the email registered with the selected account.

 Post-Installation 
 Grant permissions to the roles which are allowed to send account emails. Then a new tab is available on the user page which allows you to choose the type of email to send.

 Supporting this Module 
 If you want to help maintain this project, please let me know.
